purpose: Publish exact-name Fendler's sandmat card with actual true-seed macros and reciprocal narrowleaf spurge field comparison.

images.source_use: One Stan Shebs CC BY-SA 3.0 and four iNaturalist individually CC BY-NC records (Eric Keith, Andrey Zharkikh, Nathan Taylor x2) permitted only for genuinely noncommercial educational web use with credit. Three UT Austin images omitted because rights not cleared.
images.anatomy: Glabrous low round leaves, pink shoots, green smooth capsule, forked styles, gland appendages; true pale detached seed and opened fruit; 4-angled seed with source-authored 0.5mm scale and scattered depressions. Absolute maturity unverified.

genus: Pair key narrowleaf E. angusta vs rounded Fendler's sandmat supplemented with three actual seed and fruit macro views. Keeps distinct capsule/seed photo holds for E. angusta; no reverse-label confusion.
